profile.summary: The UC Berkeley History-Social Science Project is a program of the University of California, Berkeley. It provides professional development and teaching resources for K-12 history and social science teachers, including lessons aligned with ethnic studies and civics education. It is one of five regional sites of the California History-Social Science Project.
